title: How to organize the vanity drawers | Primary Bathroom
description:
To hold the grooming tools and products you actually reach for, arranged by when in the day you use them.

This is the Vanity Drawers in the Primary Bathroom. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Every drawer divided, nothing past its open-jar window, razor blades capped or in a lidded box in one corner, and a top drawer you can read in a single look without moving anything.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Empty one drawer at a time onto a towel and turn every tube, jar, and bottle over to find a date or an open-ja
Straighten: Divide by routine rather than by product type: a morning compartment, an evening compartment, and one for week
Shine: Lift the dividers out and tip the drawer over a bin, because loose powder, hair, and grit collect underneath w
Safety: Loose blades and razor cartridges in a drawer you reach into blind will find a fingertip.
Standardize: Write a count on each divider label: two lipsticks in rotation, one comb, one brush.
Sustain: On laundry day, while you are already carrying towels into the room, pull the top drawer and lift out anything

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Each drawer is divided by routine, every category carries a written count on its label, and nothing stays past its date.
